# pangolin_resource_roles (Data Source)

Lists the roles currently granted access to a Pangolin HTTP resource. The full role definition (SSH bastion settings, etc.) is available on `pangolin_roles`; this data source returns the slim summary the resource-scoped endpoint emits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the roles that currently have access to an HTTP resource.
data "pangolin_resource_roles" "app" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.app.id
}

output "role_names" {
  value = [for r in data.pangolin_resource_roles.app.roles : r.name]
}

# Detect whether the admin role is bound to the resource.
output "admin_role_attached" {
  value = anytrue([
    for r in data.pangolin_resource_roles.app.roles : r.is_admin
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the HTTP resource whose roles to list.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) Roles granted access to the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Role description.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the role.
- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the role is the built-in admin role of its organization.
- `name` (String) Display name of the role.
